extract1: "Only at night does loneliness magnify for a person. The sunlight of daytime acts as a curtain that conceals all pain. You cannot venture too far, or you might forget the direction of home; you cannot linger too long, or you might forget why you set out in the first place. Humans are often like this—standing on the mountaintop and yearning for the valley's breeze, yet longing for the mountaintop clouds when they are in the valley." —Moments We Shared
extract2: "I believe technology is not just a tool but a vital bridge for realizing creativity and solving problems."
extract3: "Comfortable with Python, TypeScript, Java and C. I have taken products through the whole path on my own: idea, design, development, packaging and release."
extract4: If you have an idea and want a working first version, get in touch.
extract5: "I am a Master of Information Technology (Artificial Intelligence) student at the University of Melbourne, where I also completed a Bachelor of Science in Computing and Software Systems. In my spare time I build small apps for users in China: the first is Mianyu, a bedtime sound app, and the second is Lijie, a strength training log. What I care about is making one specific, small thing work well."
extract6: Tools and practice projects of my own, also marked with their real status.
extract9: "As a collaborative learner, I enjoy sharing ideas and solving problems together in projects."
heroTagline: I build small apps on my own. Each one solves one specific, everyday problem.
productsIntro: Apps I design, build and run myself. Each one shows its real status; nothing unreleased is described as released.
mianyuPitch: It is late again and your mind is still at work. Let it clock off: no choosing, just one tap.
mianyuF1: 49 looping sounds (rain, noise, ASMR and more) that can be layered together
mianyuF2: Adjust each sound with gestures on its bubble, or pause one on its own
mianyuF3: Sleep timer from 5 to 240 minutes with a slow fade-out
mianyuF4: Saved mixes and account sync; bedtime stories are in production
lijieStatus: In design · beta planned for late 2026
lijiePitch: A training log for people who lift: a plan before the session, less phone during it, visible progress after it.
lijieF1: Build the plan first, then follow it at the gym
lijieF2: Tick off each set from the lock screen without opening the app
lijieF3: A summary after each session and a weekly review based on real records
vctDesc: Crawls Valorant match schedules from vlr.gg and publishes a calendar you can subscribe to. GitHub Actions refreshes it every day, so the schedule updates itself.
avalonDesc: Online Avalon for 5 to 12 players: a deterministic rules engine with real-time play, with tool-restricted AI players planned. The first end-to-end slice is being built now.
mahjongDesc: A terminal simulator for four-player Sichuan Mahjong with pon, kan and win detection, used to evaluate fixed-strategy AI players such as an all-triplets agent.
exp1_1: Mianyu: Android client in React + Capacitor, server in Fastify + SQLite, hosted on Tencent Cloud, now at version 1.10
exp1_2: Product design, development, automated tests (118 checks), packaging and promo material, all done solo
exp1_3: Lijie: user research and core-loop design finished, development under way
exp2_1: Crawls and cleans Valorant match schedules from vlr.gg with Python
exp2_2: Exports .ics calendar files and offers table, card and heatmap desktop views
exp2_3: Refreshed every day by GitHub Actions, so subscribers stay in sync
svc1_2: From requirements to a packaged release
svc3_3: Export to calendars, spreadsheets and more
